panels.description: Composite score using TeslaSync's documented 40-point efficiency, 30-point smoothness, and 30-point speed-discipline formula. Only completed drives with all measured inputs are scored. Orange is the 7-drive rolling average.

targets.rawSql:
WITH components AS (
  SELECT
    started_at,
    distance_m,
    avg_speed_mps,
    energy_used_wh / (distance_m / 1000.0) AS wh_per_km,
    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(40.0,
      40.0 - ((energy_used_wh / (distance_m / 1000.0)) - 130.0) / 3.0
    )) AS efficiency_points,
    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(30.0,
      30.0 - (avg_power_w / 1000.0) / 3.0
    )) AS smoothness_points,
    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(30.0,
      30.0 - GREATEST(0.0, max_speed_mps * 2.2369362920544 - 90.0) / 2.0
    )) AS speed_points
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND distance_m > 1609.344
    AND energy_used_wh > 0
    AND avg_power_w IS NOT NULL
    AND max_speed_mps IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROUND(efficiency_points + smoothness_points + speed_points)::integer AS score
  FROM components
)
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  score AS "Score",
  ROUND(AVG(score) OVER (
    ORDER BY started_at ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ))::integer AS "7-Drive Avg"
FROM scored
ORDER BY started_at

panels.description: Recent completed drives scored with TeslaSync's documented 40/30/30 efficiency, smoothness, and speed-discipline formula. Rows lacking a measured scoring input are omitted.

WITH components AS (

    distance_m,

    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(40.0,
      40.0 - ((energy_used_wh / (distance_m / 1000.0)) - 130.0) / 3.0
    )) AS efficiency_points,
    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(30.0,
      30.0 - (avg_power_w / 1000.0) / 3.0
    )) AS smoothness_points,
    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(30.0,
      30.0 - GREATEST(0.0, max_speed_mps * 2.2369362920544 - 90.0) / 2.0
    )) AS speed_points
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND distance_m > 1609.344
    AND energy_used_wh > 0
    AND avg_power_w IS NOT NULL
    AND max_speed_mps IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROUND(efficiency_points + smoothness_points + speed_points)::integer AS score
  FROM components
)
SELECT
  started_at AS "📅 Date",
  ROUND(convert_distance(distance_m / 1609.344)::numeric, 1) AS "📏 Distance",
  ROUND(convert_speed(avg_speed_mps * 2.2369362920544)::numeric, 1) AS "🚗 Avg Speed",
  score AS "⭐ Score",
  CASE
    WHEN score >= 90 THEN 'A+'
    WHEN score >= 80 THEN 'A'
    WHEN score >= 70 THEN 'B'
    WHEN score >= 60 THEN 'C'
    WHEN score >= 50 THEN 'D'
    ELSE 'F'
  END AS "🏅 Grade",
  ROUND(convert_efficiency(wh_per_km * 1.609344)::numeric, 0) AS "⚡ Efficiency"
FROM scored
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.description: Average normalized category scores from the same measured 40/30/30 formula used by the composite drive score.

targets.rawSql:
WITH components AS (
  SELECT
    started_at,
    distance_m,
    avg_speed_mps,
    energy_used_wh / (distance_m / 1000.0) AS wh_per_km,
    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(40.0,
      40.0 - ((energy_used_wh / (distance_m / 1000.0)) - 130.0) / 3.0
    )) AS efficiency_points,
    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(30.0,
      30.0 - (avg_power_w / 1000.0) / 3.0
    )) AS smoothness_points,
    GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(30.0,
      30.0 - GREATEST(0.0, max_speed_mps * 2.2369362920544 - 90.0) / 2.0
    )) AS speed_points
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND distance_m > 1609.344
    AND energy_used_wh > 0
    AND avg_power_w IS NOT NULL
    AND max_speed_mps IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROUND(efficiency_points + smoothness_points + speed_points)::integer AS score
  FROM components
)
SELECT category AS "Category", ROUND(AVG(value)::numeric, 0) AS "Score"
FROM scored
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('Efficiency'::text, efficiency_points / 40.0 * 100.0),
  ('Smoothness'::text, smoothness_points / 30.0 * 100.0),
  ('Speed'::text, speed_points / 30.0 * 100.0)
) category_scores(category, value)
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
